headline: Steady execution

highlights: Refer to Important Disclosures at the end of this report BUY Hindustan Aeronautics Steady execution; maintain BUY Defense  Result Update  November 13, 2026 CMP (Rs): 4,840 | TP (Rs): 5,950 Hindustan Aeronautics (HAL) reported revenue of Rs76.1bn (+14.9% yoy), above our estimate of Rs70.6bn.
EBITDA at Rs17.4bn (+11.6% yoy) was in line with our estimate of Rs16.7bn.

We remain confident about HAL’s business prospects, as India is in the midst of modernizing its armed forces due to (1) equipment obsolescence and (2) the prevailing adverse geopolitical situation, driving strong orders for fighter aircraft and helicopters, along with their respective engines and accessories.
We expect HAL to deliver strong operational performance over FY26–29E, supported by a pickup in the execution of its Tejas Mk-1A order.
